data.summary: The brief asks for a ring of townhouse-style apartments around a green courtyard garden, five storeys high, oriented to the sun. I read it as a courtyard typology with a strong wish for daylight and a usable garden, and no stated unit count or sizes.
unclear: Pitched roofs are requested but the tool only builds simple volumes, so the roof form cannot be checked.
A closed ring around a courtyard can conflict with turning the homes towards the sun, since some wings will face away from it.
Townhouse apartments suggest ground-related homes, which sits oddly with five storeys.
The number of homes and the unit size are not given.
The gutter height limit is unknown, so the fit of a pitched roof at five storeys cannot be confirmed.
